spans.s:
तुह् तुह्, cl. 1. P. तोहति, &c., to hurt,
pain, kill.

तुहर तुहर, अस्, m., N. of one of the
attendants of Skanda; (also written तुहार.)

तुहिन तुहिन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
तुह्), cold, frigid, frosty; (अम्), n. mist, dew, snow,
frost, cold; moonlight, moonshine; camphor; (आ),
f., N. of a tree, = शुक-नास; [cf. तुषार; Hib.
deigh, ‘ice.’]
—तुहिन-कण, अस्, m. a dew-drop;
snow-flake.
—तुहिन-किरण, अस्, m. ‘cold-rayed,’
the moon.
—तुहिनकिरण-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son
of the moon, the planet Mercury.
—तुहिन-गु, उस्,
m. ‘having cold rays,’ the moon.
—तुहिन-द्युति,
इस्, m. or तुहिन-रश्मि, इस्, m. ‘cold-rayed,’ the
moon.
—तुहिन-शर्करा, f. a piece of ice, ice.
—तुहिन-शैल, अस्, m. a snowy mountain, a snowy
peak, the Himālaya.
—तुहिनांशु (˚न-अं˚), उस्,
m. ‘cold-rayed,’ the moon; camphor.
—तुहिनांशु-
तैल, अम्, n. oil of camphor.
—तुहिनाचल (˚न-
अच्˚), अस्, m. or तुहिनाद्रि (˚न-अद्˚), इस्, m. a snow
mountain, a snowy peak, the Himālaya.

तुहुण्ड तुहुण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava;
of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
